pronunciation.approximation: Say "hebe" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Hebe".

domains.title: Hebe
domains.subtitle: Youth
domains.lead: Hebe is youth, cupbearer. The name means "Youth (from ἥβη)" and belongs to the greek tradition.

mythology.lead: The stories of Hebe place youth, cupbearer at the center of a living mythological world.

myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Hebe appears in greek tradition as youth, cupbearer. The name's meaning, "Youth (from ἥβη)", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Hebe in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Hebe remains a touchstone for understanding greek religion, art, and identity.
scholarlySources: Hesiod, Theogony and Works and Days.
